clips.title: The story
paras: Young tauren hunters gather Battleboar Snouts near Red Cloud Mesa as the Bristleback press into their hunting grounds. The snouts also go into stews for the young in Camp Narache.

Bristleback quilboar train battleboars in Brambleblade Ravine, in the shadow of Red Cloud Mesa, to probe tauren hunting grounds. Grull Hawkwind sends young braves to push back against the encroachment. A snout proves that a battleboar has been brought down. The tauren use the snouts with cuts of flank in rich stews for their young.
